Tawaqaa توقّى

Your role

Explore
GitHub
Awards
Grand Special Award, SGiE 2024

The problem

When heavy rain hits Jeddah, water collects on roads and cars stall or get swept off course. Drivers can't tell which streets are flooded, and authorities receive repeated, unclassified reports they can't safely verify in the rain.

What we built

An Android app where citizens report flooded streets by name or map pin. Reports are counted and ranked per street, a water-level sensor measures the hotspot, and a YOLOv10 model flags flooded cars and people in the water. Drivers get danger alerts and a safer route; authorities see everything on a live web console.

Outcome

Built and tested end to end: user accounts, reporting, ranked alerts with danger levels, a hazard map, a Firebase-synced authority console that closes resolved reports, a working detection model and a sensor that measures water height.

The interface reimagined as a 43-second walkthrough: report, classify, measure, detect, reroute and respond.Loop · 0:43

The idea

Departments track work across email, spreadsheets and memory. Masar gives every task an owner and visible steps, and keeps finished work on record.

What I built

A task workspace with separate views for members, department heads, HR and administrators. Heads see progress by group and average days to complete; members work through steps on a board. New staff get accounts from HR and set a password on first sign-in.

Details that matter

Full Arabic and English with right-to-left layout, Hijri and Gregorian dates side by side, dark mode, and live updates when a teammate finishes a step.

Sign in with an employee ID. New staff choose their password on first sign-in.01 / 06

Fridge & Friends

Type
iOS app concept
Role

Completed

The idea

Cook with what's already in your fridge. Your ingredients jump into the bowl, and a crew of characters tells you what you can make.

What I made

A full app concept and a working motion prototype: ingredient picking, recipe reveals, step-by-step cooking with timers and a celebration at the end. Every screen change is a checkerboard wipe, and every character reacts to what you do.

  • Cook with what's already in your fridge: pick your ingredients and the crew suggests a dish.

  • The signature interaction: ingredients tumble off their tiles and land in the bowl.

  • Every dish gets its own character, pattern and nutrition per serving.

  • Twelve rubber-hose characters, all built from one kit of eyes, gloves and sneakers.

  • Home, step-by-step cooking with timers, and the celebration screen.

  • The brand system: Lobster, Fraunces and Nunito on a cream, tomato, mustard and mint palette.

I'mLujain.

Open to roles

I'm a backend-focused software engineer from Jeddah. I build REST APIs, relational data models and real-time services, and I take them from requirements through testing and CI to deployment. I built Masar, a NestJS and PostgreSQL platform for government departments, and led Tawaqaa, which won the Grand Special Award at SGiE 2024. I studied Software Engineering at the University of Jeddah and graduated with a GPA of 4.48 / 5.0.
